items.source: Specialization of JavaExec to be used as a base class for tasks that perform ahead-of-time processing.
items.translation: `JavaExec` 类的特化版本，用作执行提前处理任务的基类。

items.source: Support for ahead-of-time processing of an application built with Gradle.
items.translation: 支持使用 Gradle 构建的应用程序的前置处理。
